title: Can't unmute audio by middle-clicking tray icon after disabling it with button in tray popup
line: Middle-clicking the volume icon or pressing the mute key now unmutes a speaker that was muted from the popup.
explanation: The popup's mute button mutes the device itself, while middle-click and the mute key toggle a separate global mute. With the device already muted, the first middle-click turned on the global mute and the second turned it off, but the global mute only unmutes devices it muted itself, so the speaker stayed muted while the OSD said 100%. Now, when no global mute is active and the default device is muted, the toggle unmutes that device; otherwise it toggles the global mute as before. The same is done for the microphone mute key, and the tray tooltip says 'Middle-click to unmute' when the default device is muted.

commits.message:
kded: Unmute a muted default device with the mute shortcut

Muting a device in the applet and then middle-clicking the tray icon or
pressing the mute key enabled the global mute on top, and turning it off
left the device muted. Now the toggle first unmutes the default device.

BUG: 527141

media.caption: Master: device muted in the popup (1), middle-click shows 'Audio Muted' (2), second middle-click shows 100% (3) but the speaker stays muted (4).
Fixed: device muted in the popup (1), the first middle-click unmutes it (2), the second mutes all audio (3, 4).

review.text: Although unmuting a muted default device on middle-click addresses the single-device repro, placing that branch directly inside muteAction and muteMicAction introduces two serious regressions. First, the applet's 'Force mute all playback devices' and 'Force mute all input devices' menu actions invoke GlobalService.globalMuteSinks()/globalMuteSources(), which trigger those exact actions—so clicking 'Force mute all...' when the default device is muted now unmutes it instead of muting all devices. Second, checking only m_preferredDevice means if another speaker is playing or a secondary microphone is live while the default device is muted, pressing Mute or Mic Mute unmutes the default device and leaves the other devices live, directly triggering the safety/privacy hazard raised by cwo in comment #4.
changes: Keep the explicit 'Force mute all playback devices' and 'Force mute all input devices' actions in applet/main.qml strictly toggling global mute, rather than routing them through the unmute-default-device branch.

Only unmute the default sink/source on Mute / Mic Mute / middle-click when no other active output/input device is currently unmuted; otherwise enable global mute first so pressing mute never leaves audio playing or a microphone live.
Guard against DUMMY_OUTPUT_NAME (auto_null) in AudioShortcutsService and in applet/main.qml's tooltip condition so a muted dummy output is not treated as an unmutable speaker.
Verify multi-device scenarios (default device muted while a second output or mic is unmuted, plus clicking 'Force mute all playback/input devices' while the default device is muted).

reviews.text: The middle-click/mute-key path is fixed and the screenshots prove it, but the change lives in the kded 'mute' action, which is also what the applet's checkable 'Force mute all playback devices' and 'Force mute all input devices' context/hamburger menu items call (GlobalService.globalMuteSinks/Sources). With the patch, choosing 'Force mute all …' while the default device is device-muted unmutes that device instead of muting everything; for inputs that makes another mic or the default mic live from an item labelled 'force mute', which is exactly the risk cwo raised in c4. The patch also changes microphone behaviour (bug 511276) without referencing that bug, and encodes the design decision cwo said is still open.
changes: Keep the explicit 'Force mute all playback/input devices' menu items as a pure global-mute toggle: give the 'unmute the muted default device first' behaviour its own entry point (e.g. a separate GlobalService/kded method used only by middle-click and the mute keys) and verify the menu items still force-mute with a device-muted default.
Either drop the microphone change or add 'CCBUG: 511276' (or BUG: 511276 if it fully closes it) and mention it in the commit message.
Re-verify the right-click/hamburger 'Force mute all' items and the mic mute key after the split.
